question: INS Imphal visited Mauritius for its maiden port call & participated in the 57th Mauritius National Day celebrations on March 12. Which type of ship is INS Imphal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indigenous destroyer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **INS Imphal arrived at Port Louis, Mauritius, for its maiden port call and participated in the 57th Mauritius National Day celebrations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Imphal is an indigenous destroyer, part of the Project 15B Visakhapatnam-class destroyers.**
 
• **It is equipped with advanced weaponry, sensors, and machinery, making it one of the most sophisticated warships in the world.**
 
• **The ship participated in Mauritius' National Day celebrations, showcasing India-Mauritius maritime collaboration.**
 
• During the celebrations, Imphal contributed a marching contingent, a naval band, and a helicopter for the ceremonial flypast at the National Day Parade at **Champs de Mars.**
 
• The event was graced by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who attended as the Chief Guest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Imphal__

 __
 
• Commissioned in December 2023, it is the third of the four Project 15B indigenous destroyers.
 
 
 
• Mauritius National Day__
 
 
• Celebrated on March 12, marking the country’s independence and the democratic values of the nation.
 
• Capital: Port Louis
 
• Currency: Mauritian Rupee
 
• Prime minister: Navin Ramgoolam
